summary.intent: Fix a failing ultraplan session creation caused by git repository corruption, then reduce the 14GB bundle size using LFS, and finally resolve bash access issues in headless Claude sessions.
summary.outcome: All three core problems were resolved: git tree corruption fixed (157 bad trees → 0), bundle reduced from 14GB to ~588MB via LFS migration and history purge, and headless bash access restored by disabling CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB. Additionally: secrets scrubbed from history, GitHub remote connected, 6 GitHub security alerts resolved, plugin bloat reduced from 15 to 6, and cross-platform health sentinel deployed.

repo: Entire.io 'carry forward: uncommitted session files' has a bug where files outside the repo root (e.g., ~/.claude/plans/) are committed with absolute paths, creating tree entries with empty filenames — a hard parse error git cannot recover from

git lfs migrate import creates refs/replace/ refs that keep old blobs alive even after repack; these must be explicitly deleted with `git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/replace/ | xargs git update-ref -d` before GC can reclaim space
git repack -Ad does not prune unreachable objects when replace refs exist; the clean path is bundle round-trip (bundle → clone from bundle → swap object store)
Entire.io shadow branches (entire/<id>) are designed to be local-only and must never be pushed via git push --all; accumulate to 1,048 without entire clean --all
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 in settings.json strips env vars needed by the sandbox, silently breaking bash access in all headless/subprocess Claude sessions
settings.json statusLine field requires both type: 'command' and command: 'string'; an object with only refreshInterval causes the ENTIRE settings file to be silently skipped
GitHub secret scanning blocks force-push even after scrubbing HEAD; requires filter-repo pass on full history AND explicit API resolution of alerts
The cohezion repo had 22GB of redundant archives (backup tarballs of work already in branches) and 7.1GB of JSONL session telemetry committed to git history

code.finding: Log injection vulnerability: f-string logging with user input allows crafted inputs to forge log entries. Fixed by switching to %s parameterized logging style.

workflow: git bundle create --all fails with 'fatal: empty filename in tree entry' when any reachable commit contains a tree entry with an empty name — transfer.fsckObjects=false cannot bypass this as it is a hard parse failure
GitHub's secret scanning auto-closes code scanning alerts on next scan push but does NOT auto-close secret scanning alerts after history scrub; must be resolved via API
Plugin bloat (15 plugins, 200+ skills) causes built-in CLI commands like /ultraplan to be intercepted by skill routing before the built-in handler runs
git filter-repo --replace-text with a replacements file is the correct tool for scrubbing secrets from all history; git rebase/amend only affects individual commits
LFS objects are excluded from git bundles entirely — only 130-byte pointer files are included — making LFS the correct solution for reducing ultraplan bundle sizes
For git object store cleanup after history rewrites, swapping the object store via bundle round-trip is more reliable than repack -Ad when replace refs exist
entire clean --all should be run periodically (monthly) to prevent shadow branch accumulation; the tool itself identifies orphaned items
Pi TypeScript extensions fail with 'Invalid package config' when package.json is 0 bytes; requires minimal valid JSON with type: 'module' for ESM resolution

friction: Force-push deny rules in settings.json blocked legitimate history rewrites multiple times, requiring manual temporary removal and restoration of the deny rule
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was silently breaking all headless Claude sessions, subagents, and agent teams — not discovered until end of session
GitHub secret scanning blocked the push even after HEAD was redacted; required full history scrub AND explicit API resolution of all 7 alerts
git repack -Ad silently failed to reclaim space because replace refs (created by lfs migrate) kept old blobs alive — not obvious from documentation
The 14GB object store remained bloated even after filter-repo + repack because refs/replace/ refs were not documented as a side effect of lfs migrate import
/ultraplan was intercepted by the skill routing system (hookify plugin) and reported as 'Unknown skill' instead of executing as a built-in command
bundle size grew from 182MB to 724MB after the token scrub filter-repo pass (re-expanded branch histories during text replacement), though still far below original 14GB
Entire.io branches with embedded .git directories (hasDotgit) could not be pushed, requiring local deletion
open_items: Weekly cron job for entire clean --all and repo health expires after 7 days (Claude Code limitation); needs GitHub Actions scheduled workflow for permanent automation
28 remaining informational (null severity) code scanning alerts on GitHub not yet triaged
3 stale Entire.io shadow branches remain on GitHub remote (deleted locally, will age out or need manual GitHub UI cleanup)
MCP server drift detected: 15 vs 16 vs 12 MCP servers across Claude/Gemini/Pi platforms — needs manual reconciliation
CodeQL alert for forge.py:114 log injection fixed in HEAD but awaiting next scheduled CodeQL scan to auto-close
Bundle size is 588MB (vs 182MB immediately post-LFS, grew during token scrub); further reduction possible with another filter-repo pass targeting remaining large blobs
